decisions.reason: The Page 24 instruction changes the crop to reveal more of the tree; it does not change which photos must be included or where they must be placed.
The photo-crop instruction does not change the background treatment required for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
This localized Page 24 photo-crop revision does not alter the document-wide layout, coverage, spacing, or design strategy.
The Page 24 picture is unrelated to the one-page proposal letter, signature insertion, and handling of photographs displaced from the letter.
Changing how much of a tree is visible in a photograph has no effect on typeface or font-size consistency.
The Page 24 crop adjustment does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, colors, or logo source.
The instruction concerns visibility within a photograph and does not resolve or change required narrative or section content.
The Page 24 photo-crop revision does not reorder or otherwise change the fixed RFQ section sequence.
The requested crop adjustment does not change Canva ownership, editing access, asset restrictions, or source-deliverable requirements.
Showing more of the tree within the existing Page 24 photograph does not necessarily change the document page limit or compaction rules.
A task-local crop revision to one proposal photograph does not change the deferred reusable-template requirements.
The Page 24 photograph instruction does not affect inclusion or replacement of proposal tables.
